problems.issue: Relying solely on a Facebook page instead of a dedicated business website limits brand ownership, search engine visibility, and advanced booking or patient management integration.
problems.impact: Misses potential patients searching independently on Google and restricts the clinic's ability to showcase comprehensive services and professional credentials.

problems.issue: Low social proof and engagement metrics visible in metadata (only ~998 followers and minimal active interaction indicators).
problems.impact: May reduce trust among prospective dental patients comparing local clinics in the Manila area.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-optimized website with an integrated online appointment booking system to capture high-intent local search traffic.
Implement structured local SEO schema (Dentist/MedicalClinic) to improve local map pack and organic search rankings in Manila and Malate.
Leverage patient testimonials and before-and-after case studies on the landing pages to build higher conversion trust.
audit.summary: While DSDY Dental Clinic maintains an active social media presence on Facebook, the lack of an official independent website limits their digital footprint, patient conversion capabilities, and local search engine dominance.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on DSDY Dental Clinic's online presence
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking at DSDY Dental Clinic's Facebook page and noticed you're doing great work helping patients in Malate. 

Relying only on Facebook instead of an independent website makes it tough to show up on Google when locals search for dentists, and under 1,000 followers can sometimes make new patients hesitate compared to clinics with a stronger digital footprint.

We actually put together a quick, live demo of a clean, professional website tailored for DSDY Dental to help fix this. 

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
